name: LinkGuard NT
author: nurullah2007

sections.description:
LinkGuard NT is a modern, PHPCS-clean, and security-focused WordPress plugin designed to detect, monitor, and fix broken links across your site.

It scans both internal and external links, identifies redirects and 404 errors, and helps you repair issues quickly using an intuitive dashboard.

This plugin is ideal for:
* SEO specialists
* Content editors and bloggers
* Agencies auditing large websites
* Developers who need a clean, secure link-checking tool

Key Features

  • Scan posts, pages, and custom post types for broken links
  • Detect 404 pages, redirects, timeouts, and unreachable URLs
  • Fix links instantly: change, delete, or restore
  • AJAX-powered dashboard with filters + pagination
  • Scheduled automatic scans (hourly, twice daily, daily, weekly)
  • CSV export
  • Security-hardened (nonces, permission checks, prepared SQL)
  • Fully translation-ready (English + Turkish included)

Localization

This plugin includes the following translation files located in /languages/:

  • linkguard-nt.pot
  • linkguard-nt-en_US.po
  • linkguard-nt-en_US.mo
  • linkguard-nt-tr_TR.po
  • linkguard-nt-tr_TR.mo

Credits

Developed by Nurullah Tayipoğlu
Website: https://profiles.wordpress.org/nurullah2007/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the linkguard-nt folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to LinkGuard NT in your admin menu.
  4. Run your first scan.
  5. Configure optional scheduled scans under Settings.
sections.faq:
Does LinkGuard NT slow down my website?

No. All scans run efficiently in the background using AJAX and optimized SQL queries.

Does it check external links?

Yes. Both internal and external URLs are fully scanned.

Does the plugin modify posts automatically?

No. You have full control. All changes occur only when you confirm them.

Is it multisite-compatible?

Yes. LinkGuard NT works on WordPress multisite installations.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. English (en_US) and Turkish (tr_TR) are included.
New translations can be added via .po/.mo files or plugins like Loco Translate.
